command:
cat > /tmp/test-wait3.tape << 'TAPE'
Output test-wait3-out.gif
Set Shell "bash"
Set Width 1200
Set Height 600

Type "cargo test --test bc_150_drain_loop_dry_tests 2>&1"
Enter
Sleep 10s
TAPE
vhs /tmp/test-wait3.tape 2>&1
echo "EXIT: $?"
ls -la test-wait3-out.gif 2>/dev/null && echo "GIF created"
rm -f test-wait3-out.gif
